![](../../figures/ecb-ces-2025.svg){fig-alt="41% of euro area workers used AI in their work in 2025, up from 26% in 2024."}

The ECB has not published the 2025 wave on its own. The 41% is from the August 2026 post on the 2026 wave, which also reports that 43% of workers expected technological advances such as AI to affect their job positively in 2025 (41% in 2026). An [ECB speech of 23 March 2026](https://www.ecb.europa.eu/press/key/date/2026/html/ecb.sp260323_1~1e06784a89.en.html) gives 40% for 2025.
